title: Ring fate and methyl stereoisomer interconversion after one-electron oxidation
difficulty_reasons: The supplied H, Me and Ph substrates require comparative evidence for ring-opening accessibility and ring-closed/ring-opened electronic energies in post-oxidation doublet models.
Methyl cis/trans stability and interconversion must be compared under a common reference, with relative stereochemistry preserved.

The series conclusion requires actual tests of the Ph ring-closed state and careful treatment of method-dependent energies without expanding into oxidation potentials, aldehyde formation or isotope provenance.
